rdev-01-c3.text: Palladius (tr. W. K. Lowther Clarke / Pearse edition) (1918). The Lausiac History, ch. 18 Macarius of Alexandria. Christian Classics Ethereal Library (Calvin University).
rdev-01-c3.quote: Where did you get this fleshless man from, to condemn us? Either drive him out, or know that we are all going.
rdev-01-c3.claim: tells how he entered a Pachomian monastery in disguise and outdid its monks through all of Lent, until they complained to the abbot
